title: Line sketch: at Dusk
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A striking blooms against a serene sky with a glowing sun on the horizon. The dramatic lighting highlights the flower's velvety petals and leaves (derived from painting #248).
